rationale: Although SNEX exhibits strong downward momentum following yesterday's massive selloff and currently trades well below VWAP and its 5-minute 9-EMA, the bid-ask spread is very wide at 30.9 bps ($0.11, or roughly 40% of the 5-minute ATR).
